packageRules.description: Every tile bump arrives as ONE weekly PR. Twenty-three tiles updating independently is a firehose nobody reads, and a review queue that large gets rubber-stamped, which is worse than no review.

Major bumps are decisions, never updates, and are never automerged. uptime-kuma 1.x to 2.x is the worked example: a different base image, a migration, and an owed ACC-1 bench. Each gets its own PR so it can be argued on its own terms.
prBodyNotes: :warning: **Major version.** Needs an ACC-1 bench before shipping, and the compose stack may need changes upstream made. Check the app-level vulnerability comparison in CI: a raw count increase is often a stale base image rather than worse dependencies — see `provenance/`.

packageRules.description: Keep Renovate's own action current; it is the thing opening PRs against the repo that will hold the signing surface.
